title: Auto-rebuild stale search index inside runSearch
description: WHY: runSearch fails closed - loadFreshSearchIndex throws when the persisted index hash does not match the expected corpus hash (apps/cli/src/search-cli.ts lines 117-138). Integrity-wise that is correct, but from an executing agent mid-task the effect is search does not work, and an agent that hits the error will fall back to memory and re-derive scope, which is exactly when it invents. The index is invalidated by every mutation, so this fires constantly. WHAT: when the index is stale or missing, rebuild it inline via writeSearchIndex (already lock-guarded, search-cli.ts lines 49-57) and then serve the query; add a --no-rebuild flag preserving the current fail-closed behavior for callers that want it. The fresh default replaces any need for a separate --fresh escape hatch.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk search query on a workspace with a stale index returns results without a manual bwrk search index run
bwrk search query --no-rebuild on a stale index still fails closed with the existing error
Concurrent search invocations do not corrupt the index thanks to the existing file lock, covered by a test
closedReason: Implemented and verified in checkpoint ffa6c80a.
